info.title: SHAPI advisory stripe-endive-payment-intent-payment-method-types-removed
info.summary: Stripe 2026-09-30.endive removes payment_method_types from Payment Intent create, update and confirm

workflows.summary: Shows the change: From API version 2026-09-30.endive, payment_method_types is no longer writable on Payment Intents: create, update and confirm requests that send it return a 400 error. It stays a read-only property on the Payment Intent, listing the computed payment methods.
